blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Meadows
District = SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows.
The Fairways — 19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way

A resort-style condominium complex on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, developed by Magusta Development, whose own portfolio page describes "an exclusive collection of 268 resort-style homes" built around a courtyard, with a Residents' Club overlooking the golf course offering exercise facilities, a massage space, a lounge and kitchen, and a games room. MLS listing records for units at both addresses record sub-type Apartment/Condo, subdivision name The Fairways, year built 2007, title to land Freehold Strata, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, sauna/steam room, bike room, guest suite, caretaker and in-suite laundry; one listing records a new roof in 2022. Pet position is listing-level only: listings describe the complex as pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one ground-floor listing states "one dog or up to two cats welcome".
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: The closest official planning name for its southern edge is the North Lougheed Area (approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road).
There's one strata complex: The Fairways, on Meadow Gardens Way at the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, on the area's south edge. The rest of the area is houses and farms in the Pitt Polder.

Transit: the R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road to Pitt Meadows Station; and route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. There's no West Coast Express station in the area (Pitt Meadows Station is south of Lougheed Highway), and I don't know of any bus serving the rural north.

Schools: SD42 catchments are set by address, and Pitt Meadows has no middle schools (elementary K–7, then secondary). Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Road) is in the area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Avenue) is just south of it.

Parks: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road (concession, spray park, skate park, playground, walking trail, ball diamonds, outdoor pool, basketball court); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; the Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River in the rural north, are on the City heritage register.

Health: the nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge (24/7 emergency); the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121-11900 Haney Place, Maple Ridge, open 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week. Pitt Meadows has no hospital.

Flood/ALR setting: over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain per the City's 2020 Business Plan, protected by roughly 60 km of dikes, and this sub-area is the low Pitt Polder land drained by floodboxes and pump stations (Alouette Pump Station, Fenton and Pitt Polder catchments). Most of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve.

"North Meadows" is the real estate board's name for the part of Pitt Meadows north of Lougheed Highway (Highway 7), covering Highland Park, Wildwood, Harris Road north and the rural Pitt Polder beyond. The City doesn't publish a boundary for it; the closest is the North Lougheed Area, about 50 ha on the north side of Lougheed Highway between Meadow Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road.

The only condos are on Meadow Gardens Way, at the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, where The Fairways is. Otherwise, homes for sale here are mostly large farm acreages on Richardson Road and Hale Road and boat-access cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake.

SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) and catchments are address-based; the School Locator check for 18961 Advent Road returned Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary, plus French Immersion options.

Parks and landmarks: Harris Road Park (12474 Harris Road), with a spray park, skate park, outdoor pool and ball diamonds; Grabenhorst Garden (13895 Harris Road); and Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River. Heritage sites include the Japanese Canadian Hall (19089 Advent Road) and the Pitt Meadows School House (13414 Harris Road). There's no library here; Pitt Meadows Public Library is at 200-12099 Harris Road.
The area boundary runs down Advent Road. If you search "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street, you'll find Advent Road; if you search by area, it won't be under North Meadows.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street. Meadowland Village (18960 Advent Rd) is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative (19032 Advent Rd) is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever listed as a strata sale. Both are board-classed with Central Meadows and covered there.
The golf course condos are the area's only strata. Sources differ on the details, including how many units there are; the strata plan (BCS2427) and Form B will settle them.

The rural north has no bus. Confirmed transit is all on the Lougheed/Harris south edge (R3, 701, 719); the Pitt Polder farm roads have no confirmed route at all, which matters for any buyer planning to age in place without driving.

The North Lougheed Area Plan is adopted but not built. OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 covers roughly 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway, and the City states development will proceed gradually with further planning, studies and Council approvals.

items.t: The Advent Road school and the Advent Road 55+ pocket are in different sub-areas on paper. Highland Park Elementary stands at 18961 Advent Rd inside North Meadows, while the Meadowland Village / Meadowlands co-op pocket further along Advent Road is board-classified Central Meadows. Street name alone does not settle sub-area — the board label on the listing does.
The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the land base is in the floodplain. The 95% figure governs.

The Codd Island Wetlands are undiked. Unlike the diked urban and farm land around them, the Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River are undiked floodplain wetlands on the City heritage register — flood protection in the rural north is pump-and-floodbox drainage, not a uniform dike ring.
Rural servicing is a per-lot question. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application, and an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in North Meadows
Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Community figures: detached median $1,160,000, $550/sq ft, 95%, 41 days; attached median $662,500, $566/sq ft, 97%, 40 days.

Schools (SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows, with no middle schools: K–7 elementary, then secondary): Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Road) is in the area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Avenue) is just south.

Transit, roads and health: the R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road to Pitt Meadows Station, south of Lougheed (there's no West Coast Express station in this area); and route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) is the south edge. The nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital (11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge, 24/7 emergency). Harris Road Park is at 12474 Harris Road, and the library is at 200-12099 Harris Road, south of the area.
Pitt Meadows community Condos & Townhomes median was $662,500 ($566/sqft, 97% sale-to-list, 40 days) — a community figure, not North Meadows'.

Schools (SD42): Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Road), in the area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Avenue), the city's only public secondary school. SD42 has no middle schools (K–7 and 8–12). Catchments are set by address; for 18961 Advent Road, the School Locator gives Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary, plus French Immersion options.
No West Coast Express station is in this sub-area.

Parks and health care: Harris Road Park (12474 Harris Road), Grabenhorst Garden (13895 Harris Road) and Codd Island Wetlands (undiked, on the City's heritage register); heritage sites include the Japanese Canadian Hall (19089 Advent Road). There's no library here; Pitt Meadows Public Library is at 200-12099 Harris Road. The nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge.

Taxes, rebates and financing: property transfer tax is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% up to $2 million and 3% above, plus another 2% on the residential part above $3 million. First-time buyers are exempt on the first $500,000 for homes up to $835,000, with a partial exemption up to $860,000; the newly built home exemption is full up to $1,100,000 and ends at $1,150,000. For example, at $662,500 (the city's condo and townhome median) with no exemption, the tax is $2,000 + $9,250 = $11,250. The first-time buyers' GST rebate (law since March 13, 2026) covers all the GST on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out at $1.5 million, for agreements from March 20, 2025 to 2031. The GST New Housing Rebate is 36% up to $6,300 (phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000). The Home Buyers' Plan allows $60,000, an FHSA $8,000 a year up to $40,000, and CMHC premiums run 0.6%–4.5%. GST applies to new homes, not resales (The Fairways, built in 2007, is a resale), and Vancouver's Empty Homes Tax doesn't apply.

The area boundary runs down Advent Road. On MLS®, 18960 Advent Road (Meadowland Village, 55+) is in Central Meadows, while Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road, across the street, is in North Meadows. If you search "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street, you'll find Advent Road; if you search by area, it won't be under North Meadows.

The school and the 55+ pocket on Advent Road sit in different sub-areas on paper. Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Rd) is inside North Meadows; the Meadowland Village / co-op pocket further along Advent Road is board-classified Central Meadows.
Sources differ on the floodplain share. The City 2020 Business Plan says over 95%. Confirm the current figure with the City.
Codd Island Wetlands are undiked. Flood protection in the rural north is pump-and-floodbox drainage, not a uniform dike ring — a per-lot servicing and flood check belongs in every rural offer here.

Pitt Meadows, September 2026: the detached median was $1,160,000 ($550 per sq ft, 95% of list price, 41 days on the market), and the condo and townhome median $662,500 ($566 per sq ft, 97%, 40 days).

Schools, SD42 (no middle tier in Pitt Meadows — elementary K–7, secondary 8–12): Highland Park Elementary, 18961 Advent Road, is physically in the sub-area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, sits south of the sub-area.

Transit: the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus (Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place) stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road along the south edge, stopping at Pitt Meadows Station; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road as part of the combined 719/722 service.

Parks and health: Harris Road Park (12474 Harris Road), with a concession, spray park, skate park, playground, walking trail, ball diamonds, outdoor pool and basketball court; Grabenhorst Garden (13895 Harris Road); and Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River in the rural north, on the City's heritage register. Pitt Meadows Public Library is at 200-12099 Harris Road, south of the area, and the nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital (11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge), with 24/7 emergency care.
Pitt Meadows community — Detached median $1,160,000; attached median $662,500, not North Meadows figures.

OCP — "I See Pitt Meadows 2040":, covering the whole city including this sub-area, plus the North Lougheed Area Plan, adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 (~50 ha, gradual development, further approvals required).

The board's boundary on Advent Road splits the street: Meadowland Village (18960 Advent Road) is listed in Central Meadows, while Highland Park Elementary across the street (18961 Advent Road) is in North Meadows. A search for "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street finds Advent Road, but a search of North Meadows won't.

Heritage in the rural north: sites on the City's heritage register include the Japanese Canadian Hall (19089 Advent Road), the Pitt Meadows School House (13414 Harris Road, which the City calls the most intact of the city's three remaining early school houses) and farm properties on Ford Road, plus the Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River.

The proposed North Lougheed Connector is a proposal, not a road. North Lougheed Area Plan material shows a proposed 2 km link from Abernathy Way to Lougheed Highway; it is not a built road and not a value factor for any parcel.

blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in North Meadows

What trades is fee-simple Pitt Polder farm and rural parcels under A-1 / A-2 agricultural zoning and RR rural-residential zoning, plus Highland Park and Wildwood house lots under RS / RR zoning — parcel by parcel, with no named acreage subdivision, no bare-land strata acreage community and no presale acreage offering verified on any source.
The ground in North Meadows

items.t: Agricultural parcels: A-1 General Agricultural — minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha, one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m; A-2 Large Lot Agricultural — minimum 16 ha.
Rural-residential parcels: RR-2 Large Lot Rural Residential minimum 4 ha; RR-3 minimum 2 ha; RR-4 minimum 1 ha.

Second dwellings on acreage: a garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite or a secondary suite, not both.

Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application; an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect it.

Not in North Meadows: Meadowland Village and the Meadowlands Housing Co-operative on Advent Road are listed in Central Meadows, even though Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road, across the street, is in North Meadows.

blocks.text: Where the acreages are and what to know

items.t: Main streets: Lougheed Highway (south edge), Harris Road, Advent Road, Ford Road, McNeil Road and Old Dewdney Trunk Road, with agricultural Pitt Polder land to the north and east. Nearby areas: Central Meadows, Mid Meadows, South Meadows and West Meadows (same city), Maple Ridge across the Pitt River to the east, Port Coquitlam to the west. Search names: "North Meadows", "North Meadows PI", "Highland Park", "Wildwood", "Pitt Polder".

Transit and hazards: the R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge, route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road, and route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes on the Fraser Valley floodplain, and the Pitt Polder is drained by floodboxes and pump stations.

Two nearly identical names on one street, owned in different ways: Meadowland Village is a 55+ strata where you can buy, and the Meadowlands Housing Co-operative is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares. Both are in Central Meadows, but you'll come across both names when looking in North Meadows.

Buildings in the farm zones sit back 15 m from water: Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 requires residential and agricultural buildings to be sited 15 m from watercourses, key ditches and constructed ditches in the A-1 and A-2 zones — a buildable-envelope fact that changes what a Polder parcel can actually hold.

faq.q: How many condo buildings does North Meadows have?

faq.q: Is The Fairways a 55+ building? It sits on a golf course and gets marketed to downsizers.

faq.q: How many homes are in The Fairways?

faq.a: Long-term, yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals are different: Pitt Meadows prohibits STRs at the city level, a separate layer that the strata-law change does not remove.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Fairways unit?

faq.a: Yes — one. The Fairways (19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way), a 268-home resort-style condominium complex by Magusta Development on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course; unit listings record Apartment/Condo sub-type, built 2007, freehold strata.
faq.q: Is there really a condo complex in North Meadows?

faq.a: Listing-level evidence says yes: listings call it pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one states "one dog or up to two cats welcome". Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC, so the registered bylaws in the Form B package govern for a specific purchase.
faq.q: Are pets allowed at The Fairways?

faq.a: Only down to the zone minimums in Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 — 8 ha in A-1 and 16 ha in A-2 — and, where the parcel is in the ALR, only with ALC approval; depositing a strata plan is itself a subdivision. Price no split before both frames are checked.

faq.a: A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR and RS zones, one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m (or a secondary suite, not both), and on ALR land the ALC also allows one additional detached residence to 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less where the conditions are met.
faq.q: Can an acreage lot have a second dwelling?

faq.a: No — short-term rentals are prohibited in Pitt Meadows; STR accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw. Do not price any parcel on STR income.
faq.q: Can I short-term rent the farmhouse or a cabin?

faq.a: Only if a pair was legally split — as a 2-lot strata plan or by fee-simple subdivision. Check title and plan before the form is believed.

faq.a: Largely, yes to both on the City's current figures: Over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the Fraser/Pitt floodplain behind 60 km of dikes, 78% of the city's land is in the ALR, and the northern Pitt Polder catchments drain by floodboxes and pump stations.

Short-term rentals are a different answer: they are prohibited in Pitt Meadows — short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw.
